lines.inspiration.struck: Something catches. You don't know what yet. You know it's yours, and you know it won't wait.
lines.inspiration.replaced: The other thing, the thing from before, is gone. You don't miss it. You will.
lines.inspiration.expired: Whatever it was, it's gone. You had it and you did nothing, and now it belongs to somebody else, somewhere, who will.
lines.inspiration.interrupted: And it's gone. Just like that. You could feel exactly where it had been.
lines.scavenge.nothing: Nothing. Or nothing you'd pick up, which today is a distinction you still make.
lines.scavenge.picked_clean: You've been through this already. It's picked clean, and you're the one who picked it.
lines.item.used: You finish the {item}. It does what it does.
lines.save.failed: Nothing got written down. Tomorrow you won't remember this either.
lines.making.nothing_to_work_with: You've got the idea and nothing to put it on, or nothing to put it on with. The idea doesn't care. The clock's running.
lines.making.started: You start. For once the hands know where they're going.
lines.making.working: You keep at it. It's still there, the idea, just ahead of your hands.
lines.making.abandoned.walked_away: You walk away from it. Half a thing is worse than nothing. Nothing at least doesn't look at you.
lines.making.abandoned.lost: The idea went, and the work went with it. What's left is just damage you did to something.
lines.making.covered: You went over the one that was already there. It was yours to go over.
lines.piece.artist.inspired: Done: {work}. It is exactly the thing you saw. That never happens. It happened.
lines.piece.artist.solid: Done: {work}. It's close. It's closer than you usually get.
lines.piece.artist.rough: Done: {work}. It isn't what you saw. It's what your hands did while you were busy seeing it.
lines.piece.artist.botched: It was going to be {work}. It isn't anything now. You know the exact moment it stopped being something, and you kept going anyway.
lines.work.whereabouts.none: nothing left of it but the doing
lines.game.nerve.pressed: You keep going. It's getting bigger. It's getting better. Somewhere, a car door.
lines.game.nerve.busted: Headlights. You go. What's on the wall is what was on the wall when you went.
lines.game.nerve.stopped: You cap it and walk. Not run. Walk.
lines.game.cut.pressed: You take a little more off. It's closer. It was in there the whole time.
lines.game.cut.busted: Too much. You felt it go. You can't put wood back.
lines.game.cut.stopped: You stop cutting, which is harder than cutting.
lines.game.room.crowd.cold: Nobody's looking. The ones who are looking are looking for the door.
lines.game.room.crowd.warm: A few of them are with you. They'd like to see where this goes.
lines.game.room.crowd.hot: They're with you. All of them. It's a little frightening.
lines.game.room.crowd.turning: Something's gone. You can feel them deciding about you.
lines.game.room.held: You hold it right where it is and let them come to you.
lines.game.room.bowed: You stop while it's still yours to stop.
lines.game.karaoke.crowd.cold: The room has gone back to its drinks. You're singing to a jukebox that isn't even on.
lines.game.karaoke.crowd.warm: A couple of heads are nodding. The man in the Blazers jersey mouths the words.
lines.game.karaoke.crowd.hot: They're singing it back at you. The whole bar. Badly. It's the best sound there is.
lines.game.karaoke.crowd.turning: Somebody laughs, and it isn't the good kind.
lines.game.karaoke.pushed: In your head it's the big note. In the room it's a noise. Somebody at the bar puts a hand over their drink.
lines.game.karaoke.held: In your head you're riding the chorus. In the room you're a verse behind, reading the screen out loud like it's a menu.
lines.game.karaoke.bowed: You hand back the mic. The machine clunks. Somewhere above it, a tape stops turning.
lines.game.rhymes.picked: {word}. It's a word. You said it out loud, to a beat only you can hear.
lines.inspiration.urge: You feel like doing something about it. Right now. Right here.
lines.making.encore: And you're not done. There's more where that came from. There is always, regrettably, more.
lines.game.singing.crowd.cold: Nobody's listening. That's the good part and the bad part.
lines.game.singing.crowd.warm: Somebody nearby has gone quiet in the way people do when they're listening and pretending not to.
lines.game.singing.crowd.hot: You have an audience. You didn't ask for one. It's going well anyway, which is the strangest part.
lines.game.singing.crowd.turning: Somebody looks over the way you look at a car alarm.
lines.game.singing.pushed: You let it out. It's louder than you expected. It's yours, though.
lines.game.singing.held: You keep it under your breath, where it's safe and where it's still a song.
lines.game.singing.bowed: You trail off, and the quiet comes back like it was only waiting its turn.
lines.requirement.stat: That takes more {stat} than you've got.
lines.requirement.item: You'd need the {item} for that, and you don't have it.
lines.requirement.sobriety.max: You're far too sober for that.
lines.requirement.mark: You haven't been through what that takes.
lines.requirement.time: There isn't enough of the idea left for that.
lines.requirement.busy: You're in the middle of something.
lines.location.return: Back at {place}. It's still here. So are you.
lines.perception.misfire: You reach for it, and it isn't there. It was never there. This is {place}, and it always has been.
lines.requirement.avoid: Not {target}. You can't. Your legs have already decided.
lines.psyche.save.passed: It gets its hooks in, and then, for once, it lets go.
lines.psyche.mark.again: It finds the groove it already wore and settles back in. Nothing new. Just deeper.
lines.psyche.mark.scar: That one's staying. Every time you see {target}, you'll be back there for a second.
lines.psyche.mark.phobia: You're never going near {target} again. Your body decided. Nobody asked you.
lines.psyche.mark.obsession_love: It's {target} now. It's always going to be {target}. You're fine with that, which is the problem.
lines.psyche.mark.obsession_hate: You hate {target}. You didn't used to. Now it's most of what you do.
lines.psyche.mark.needs_company: Being alone has started making a noise. It's loudest when there's nobody around to drown it out.
lines.psyche.mark.being_watched: Everyone is looking. They were always looking. Now you know.
lines.psyche.mark.the_committee: Somebody in your head has started taking minutes. There's a lot of old business.
lines.psyche.mark.the_low: There's a floor under the floor now. You've found it. You'll find it again.
lines.psyche.mark.the_high: Good moods have started going somewhere. Up. Fast. Without you.
lines.psyche.fit.flashback: {target}. For a second it's that day again, and you're the only one here who knows it.
lines.psyche.fit.panic: {target}. Your heart leaves first and the rest of you goes after it.
lines.psyche.fit.devotee: {target}. Look at it. Everyone should be looking at it. Why isn't everyone looking at it?
lines.psyche.fit.grudge: {target}. Your jaw gets there before you do.
lines.psyche.fit.empty_room: Nobody's here. The nobody gets very loud.
lines.psyche.fit.watched: They're looking. Keep your face normal. What does your face normally do?
lines.psyche.fit.committee: The committee is in session. The motion is everything, all at once. It carries.
lines.psyche.fit.the_hole: The floor gives. You go down to where it's quiet and nothing is worth it.
lines.psyche.fit.the_rocket: Everything is a good idea. All of them. Right now.
lines.act.grudge_snaps.you: {author} has been waiting all night for somebody to bring up {target}, and you're the somebody. It isn't a conversation. It's sentencing.
lines.act.grudge_snaps.you.held: {author} starts in about {target}. You let it go past you like weather. Somewhere in there {author} hears it, and it isn't a good sound.
lines.act.grudge_snaps.them: {author} turns on {recipient} about {target}. {recipient} didn't bring it up. Nobody has to bring it up. It's always up.
lines.act.grudge_snaps.them.held: {author} goes at {recipient} about {target}. {recipient} looks back the way you'd look at a dog barking at a mailbox. It lands on {author} instead.
lines.act.devotee_preaches.you: {author} tells you about {target}. You didn't ask. {author} has never once needed anyone to ask.
lines.act.devotee_preaches.them: {author} is telling {recipient} about {target}. {recipient} nods in the places where a nod is cheapest.
lines.act.flashback_stares: Somebody says something, or nothing, and {author} is back at {target} for a second. You can watch the whole trip from here. There's nothing to do about it.
lines.act.panic_shakes: {author} clocks {target}, or thinks so, and every part of {author} that can leave, leaves. The rest stays and shakes.
lines.act.hollow_asks: {author} asks if you've got anything. You've got nothing. You say so, and the two of you stand there in the truth of it.
lines.act.dennis_holds_forth: Dennis tells you what. You didn't ask. Nobody has ever asked. Back in the day, apparently, things were different, and louder.
lines.requirement.cure.none: There's nothing in you that this would reach. Yet.
lines.cure.therapy.took: You talk. He listens, which nobody does, and it costs you more than talking should. Something about {target} is a little smaller when you leave.
lines.cure.therapy.slipped: You get halfway into it and stop. He waits. You don't. An hour of two people looking at a carpet.
lines.cure.therapy.cured: You say the thing about {target} out loud, all the way through, and it stays said. It's still true. It just isn't running you.
lines.cure.self_hypnosis.took: You are calm. You are safe. You are in control. {target} comes up and, for once, you're the one who lets it go.
lines.cure.self_hypnosis.slipped: You are calm. You are safe. You are thinking about {target}. You are thinking about it worse. You rewind and it's still there.
lines.cure.self_hypnosis.cured: Side A, one more time, and something about {target} goes quiet. You did that to yourself. You'd like a witness.
lines.requirement.cure.soon: Not yet. It doesn't go faster because you want it to.
lines.cure.lapsed: You let it go long enough that some of it slid back. It was waiting the whole time.
lines.requirement.barred: Not {place}. You're 86'd. For a while, they said, and nobody said how long a while is.
lines.fight.started: {name} sees it coming and stands up anyway. Everybody in here has a story now. You're just deciding which one.
lines.fight.jab.needle.won: You find the thing and you press on it. {name} goes a colour.
lines.fight.jab.needle.lost: You reach for the thing and {name} gets there first. It's your thing now. Everyone heard.
lines.fight.jab.loom.won: You get close. Closer than the room likes. {name} gives up an inch and hates it.
lines.fight.jab.loom.lost: You get close and {name} gets closer, and now you can smell what's on the breath, and it isn't fear.
lines.fight.jab.laugh.won: You laugh. Not at anything. Just at {name}. It's the worst thing you could have done, which is why it works.
lines.fight.jab.laugh.lost: You laugh and it comes out wrong, high and thin, and {name} laughs back, and that one's real.
lines.fight.swing.first: You go first. Everybody who ever told you not to was right, and here it comes anyway.
lines.fight.walked: You walk. The room lets you. That's not the same thing as letting you off.
lines.fight.cracked.you: Your jaw gets there before you do. You're swinging. Nobody asked you.
lines.fight.cracked.them: {name} cracks. You see the exact second it happens, and then you see the fist.
lines.fight.landed.you: It lands. You didn't feel it leave and you don't feel it land, and {name} folds.
lines.fight.landed.them: It lands. The lights go a colour. The floor is very interested in you.
lines.fight.ontop.you: It's the floor, and it's {name} under you, and it's over faster than it's been going.
lines.fight.ontop.them: It's the floor, and it's {name} on top, and there is nothing to do but be under.
lines.fight.pulled: Hands. A lot of hands. Somebody's saying your name like it's a warning. It's over, and nobody won it.
lines.fight.knockout.them: {name} goes down and doesn't get up, and the room goes quiet the way it does when it has just seen something it'll be telling for a year.
lines.fight.barred: You're 86'd from {place}. For a while. They don't say how long. They never do.
lines.fight.wake.basement: You wake up in the basement. You don't remember the stairs. You never do. You always make it back. You're a raccoon.
lines.fight.wake.bush: You wake up in a bush outside Mom's. There's a sprinkler. It's been going a while. You always make it back. You're a raccoon.
lines.fight.wake.yard: You wake up in the front yard, face down in the one patch of grass Mom still waters. You always make it back. You're a raccoon.
lines.fight.swing.them: {name} comes at you. No squaring off, no speech. Just the distance closing.
lines.fight.swing.others: {first} goes at {second}. No warning. The room finds out at the same time {second} does.
lines.fight.cracked.others: {first} cracks. Everybody sees it before {second} does.
lines.fight.landed.others: {first} lands it and {second} folds, and it's over faster than the telling of it.
lines.fight.ontop.others: The floor, and {first} on top of {second}, and everybody suddenly very interested in their drink.
lines.fight.pulled.others: Hands. Everybody's hands. {first} and {second} get pulled apart still swinging at the air between them.
lines.fight.knockout.others: {first} goes down and stays down. The room goes quiet the way it does when it's just got a story.
lines.fight.watched: You didn't do anything. You watched. Something about watching gets in.
lines.act.grudge_swings.you: {author} has stopped talking about {target}. {author} is coming over.
lines.act.grudge_swings.them: {author} has stopped talking about {target} and started walking at {recipient}.
